feedback.worked_solution:
The coordinates of the point are $(2,6).$

- The real part of this complex number is $x=2,$ and

- the imaginary part is $y=6.$

Therefore, the number depicted is $z=2+6i.$ Finally, notice that 

$$
\begin{aligned}z & =2+6i \\  & =6\,i+2.\end{aligned}
$$
